prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished straight-on desktop web app Home screen, 1536x1024 landscape, for Mazi, a signed-in shared memory archive for eight friends. No device mockup or presentation annotations. Direction: The Everyday Collection. A complete welcoming consumer app in warm pale cream #FFF4E6, white soft-cornered cards, dark brown #2B241F humanist sans typography, restrained terracotta #BE482B reserved for actionable controls. Strong photography, genuinely professional spacing, not a marketing page.
Top header mazi left; Home active, Timeline, Search; My Imports and small group avatar right. Under header heading 'Good to see you again' with understated label 'Your shared memories'. Main composition a generously rounded white featured memory card across the page: left roughly 60% contains one large beautiful photograph with two subtle photo layers behind it, a shallow tactile 3D stack contained in the card; right contains title 'The night we missed the last ferry', metadata 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos', attribution 'Added by Deniz', and a large terracotta 'Open memory' button. Photograph depicts synthetic candid friends laughing on a Mediterranean terrace at dusk, blue sea, warm flash, lived-in table. Controls flat, never distorted with the stack.
Below featured card a clear 'Recently added' heading and three generous white photo cards, each holding one large natural candid photograph, title and date: 'Lake days', 'A quiet Sunday', 'Birthday weekend'. Persistent lower navigation Home / Timeline / Search rendered as comfortable labeled controls, with no duplicated extra functions. Small 'Demo memories' footer label. Elegant warm humanist sans at all sizes, beautifully readable text, proportional breathing space. No decorative charts, progress rings, public sharing, private toggles, publish button, likes, notifications, gradients, cartoon illustrations, excessive app chrome, or invented business metrics. Fully finished photographic product UI.
